description:
Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future - Piracicaba , uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Pré-requisitos:

  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;
  • Ter disponibilidade para trabalhar no modelo híbrido em Piracicaba;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI).

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro).

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.

Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Essa vaga é destinada a um pool de rede de talentos a nível Brasil, então pode ser que o retorno demore um pouco a mais do que outras vagas da XP!

Processo Seletivo

Triagem inicial: Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

Testes gerais: Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento: Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

Entrevista com a liderança: Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

Entrevista com Head Comercial: Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação.

Entrevista focada em cultura: Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Oferta: Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Benefícios:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade: O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições).

Join to apply for the Finance Manager - Brazil role at dLocal

Why should you join dLocal?
dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets.
By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being a part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.
What's the opportunity?
As the Finance Manager for Brazil, you will be responsible for overseeing all local financial operations and ensuring full compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements. You will work closely with Accounting and Foreign Exchange (FX/e-FX) functions, upholding financial integrity and ensuring alignment with local regulations
What will you be doing?

  • Oversee accounting and all financial operations in Brazil
  • Ensure full compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements (Banco Central), acting as a key liaison with regulators, auditors, and external partners
  • Design and implement financial controls, reporting processes, and strategies aligned with local and global standards
  • Oversee statutory financial reporting, tax compliance, and financial filings
  • Ensure all operations comply with local regulations, including FX/e-FX activities, cash allocation, and safeguarding
  • Partner closely with global Finance and Legal teams to align local practices with broader group strategies
  • Support business growth initiatives with financial insights and risk assessments
  • Represent the company in regulatory inspections, board meetings, and industry forums as needed
  • Serve as the Statutory Director registered with the Central Bank of Brazil (Banco Central do Brasil), ensuring full alignment with local regulatory obligations

What skills do you need?
  • 8+ years of senior financial leadership experience within regulated financial institutions in Brazil (e.g., banks, payment institutions, fintechs)
  • In-depth knowledge of Brazilian financial regulations (BACEN) with a track record of regulatory engagement
  • Proven experience in accounting management and in-depth knowledge of the regulatory framework governing FX operations
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to build and execute scalable financial frameworks
  • Hands-on leadership style, capable of both operational deep dives and high-level financial strategy
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, both internally and externally
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • A master's degree, an MBA, or a CPA/CRC certification is a strong plus
  • SAP knowledge is a plus
  • Full professional fluency in English is required

What do we offer?
Besides the tailored benefits we have for each country, dLocal will help you thrive and go that extra mile by offering you:
  • Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe!*
  • Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance
  • Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity
  • Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded
  • Learning & development: get access to a Premium Coursera subscription
  • Language classes: we provide free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes
  • Social budget: you'll get a monthly budget to chill out with your team (in person or remotely) and deepen your connections!
  • dLocal Houses: want to rent a house to spend one week anywhere in the world coworking with your team? We’ve got your back!
  • For people based in Montevideo (Uruguay) applying to non-IT roles, 55% monthly attendance to the office is required

What happens after you apply?
Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!
Also, you can check out our webpage, Linkedin, Instagram, and Youtube for more about dLocal!

Orbital Engineering’s Utility Services Department partners with Utility and Communication Companies in Engineering and Construction operations for Joint Use Pole Attachment Programs (JU), Distribution Engineering Design Projects, and Distribution System Improvement Charge (DSIC) programs, such as the Pennsylvania Long-Term Infrastructure Improvement Program (LTIIP).
This Distribution Designer position will directly support projects within the Utility Services Department’s pole attachment application process and power delivery improvement process. The Utility Services team is also responsible for analyzing requests for attachment to client’s poles and network reliability improvements on client’s electric distribution systems. Utility Services staff support GIS data analytics, creation of notifications, work orders, invoicing, and financial reports utilizing enterprise resource planning software.
Orbital Engineering, Inc. is currently seeking a Distribution Designer for our Utility Services team to support projects in Eastern Pennsylvania. Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

  • Visually identify, inspect, and record equipment and different construction situations in the field, including rights-of-way

  • As needed, must be able to work in all weather conditions and in residential, commercial, and industrial areas
  • Work is primarily office based but fieldwork may be needed throughout the engineering design process
  • Must be willing to travel overnight or for extended periods of time, based on project assignment
  • Will be required to attend meetings at clients’ sites and regularly interact with the general public, including landowners and operators
  • May occasionally enter energized extra-high voltage substations up to 745kV and will need to coordinate with appropriate utility personnel throughout fielding activities within this location
Minimum Requirements
  • High School Diploma or GED required with 3+ years of experience in fieldwork or a construction environment, drafting, utility experience, or technical design
  • Associates Degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology, or related technical discipline with 0-2 years of experience, with interest in fieldwork, or surveying

  • Ability to prioritize work on multiple projects and effectively communicate project statuses
  • Computer proficiency including general Microsoft Office products, design, and business enterprise software

  • Working knowledge of electrical distribution assets and/or communication equipment construction
  • Experience in pole loading (Spida Calc, O-Calc, Pole Foreman, or Katapult) or other construction modeling software (AutoCAD, DDS) is beneficial

  • Familiar with Safe Work Practices and PPE applications

title: LCA Lead | Life Cycle Analysis Lead
description:
About InPlanet

We are an impact-driven, remote-first, ClimateTech (CDR) startup headquartered in Germany and Brazil to reverse climate change and make tropical agriculture more regenerative, low-carbon, and sustainable. We are working with Enhanced Rock Weathering in tropical agriculture, focusing on Brazil. We do this to create a liveable planet for future generations and, specifically, to regenerate soils and ecosystems, grow nutritious food, and increase food security and sovereignty in the tropics.
People-first, Performance Culture: We believe that focus on people and performance can co-exist with the right cultural vision. Our philosophy is to blend these two essential components. The Rocket symbolizes our commitment to peak performance, excellence, and reaching new heights. The Heart represents our dedication to our people, fostering empathy, compassion, and genuine care for every team member's well-being.
We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We are proud to have an internationally growing team and we are designing our people practices to serve psychological safety, belonging, and authenticity.

Key Responsibilities

LCA Development & Execution

  • Conduct full Life Cycle Assessments (LCA) for mining, rock sourcing, transportation, and field spreading processes .
  • Ensure compliance with ISO standards , GHG Protocols, IPCC guidelines, and relevant carbon accounting frameworks .
  • Quantify the carbon footprint and co-benefits of InPlanet’s Enhanced Rock Weathering projects for emissions avoidance and reductions linked to changes in agronomic practices.

Scalability & Process Optimization

  • Develop scalable LCA methodologies to streamline assessment processes across multiple projects.
  • Integrate automation tools where possible to reduce manual data collection bottlenecks .
  • Identify opportunities for emissions reduction in our supply chain and propose actionable sustainability strategies.

Carbon Reporting & Certification

  • Produce Greenhouse Gas (GHG) statements and carbon accounting reports to support MRV (Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification) requirements .
  • Work closely with internal and external stakeholders to align LCA outputs with carbon credit certification needs .

Stakeholder & Data Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with mines and supply chain partners to facilitate accurate and timely data collection.
  • Coordinate with farmers and supply chain teams to ensure high-quality input data .
  • Troubleshoot data gaps when mines or other partners do not provide necessary information (e.g. secondary mine process data).

Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Work cross-functionally to ensure that LCA insights inform strategic decision-making at InPlanet.
  • Present findings to internal teams and external partners, communicating complex sustainability assessments in a clear and actionable manner .

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes.
  • Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency.
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change.

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience with LCA methodologies and tools (e.g., SimaPro, OpenLCA, GaBi , or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with ISO 14040/14044 LCA standards and/or GHG accounting protocols .
  • 7+ years of experience in carbon accounting and sustainability impact assessments .
  • Knowledge of mining, agriculture, or supply chain sustainability is a strong plus.
  • Ability to structure LCAs for scalability in a fast-growing company.
Key Qualities
  • High attention to detail —accuracy in sustainability reporting is critical.
  • Solution-oriented mindset —doesn’t just point out gaps, but proposes fixes and optimisations.
  • Ability to build strong relationships with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Driven and resilient —pushes forward despite data collection challenges.
  • Comfortable with uncertainty —navigates the evolving landscape of carbon markets with adaptability.
Bonus Points (but not essential)
  • Certified LCA Practitioner (ACLCA)
  • Greenhouse Gas Accounting Certification (GHG Protocol, ISO 14064)
  • Certified Carbon Auditor
  • ISO 14040/14044 LCA Training

Benefits

  • Salary expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly. Competitive.
  • Share options (ESOP) to make you feel like an owner.
  • Home Office Budget
  • Fully Remote: Join us from anywhere within the CET (- 4/5-hour time zones).
  • Personal development budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 34+ days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference, and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

About the Role

Location: Brazil (Preferably near São Paulo)
Languages: Fluent in Portuguese & English

At InPlanet, we are pioneering the use of Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) as a scalable carbon removal solution. To ensure the credibility and scientific rigor of our impact, Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) plays a critical role in evaluating the full environmental footprint of our operations—from rock sourcing to CO₂ sequestration.
As our LCA Lead, you will spearhead the development and execution of LCAs for our ongoing and future projects. You will work closely with cross-functional teams—including Science, Operations, Carbon Accounting, and Business Development—to navigate complex sustainability frameworks, structure LCA methodologies for scalability, and produce reliable greenhouse gas (GHG) assessments that feed into our carbon credit issuance process.
This is a high-impact role at the core of our mission. If you're passionate about climate solutions and have a track record of data-driven sustainability analysis, we’d love to have you on board.

The Impact You Can Make

  • Develop and execute high-quality LCAs to quantify the environmental footprint of our supply chain, from rock mining to field application.
  • Establish scalable methodologies and refine LCA frameworks that can be applied efficiently across multiple geographies and project types.
  • Enable InPlanet to meet the strictest carbon market standards , ensuring credibility in the issuance of high-quality carbon removal credits.
  • Strengthen our network by building trust with mining and farming stakeholders , optimising data collection, and improving transparency.
  • Support the integration of LCA insights into business decisions , helping to shape strategic choices around material sourcing, transportation, and field deployment.

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate.
The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach.
These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

We enable organizations of all sizes to easily build, scale, and run modern applications by helping them modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our industry-leading developer data platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud database and is available in more than 115 regions across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. Atlas allows customers to build and run applications anywhere—on premises, or across cloud providers. With offices worldwide and over 175,000 new developers signing up to use MongoDB every month, it’s no wonder that leading organizations, like Samsung and Toyota, trust MongoDB to build next-generation, AI-powered applications.
Individuals in the Associate Customer Success Manager role have a passion for technology and the ambition to dive head-first into new challenges. This is a product-led team rooted in innovation , so we are looking for someone who can thrive with a high level of ambiguity and operate with a high amount of autonomy while maintaining a customer centric approach and helping to evolve the program to engage with customers at the right time, with the right information, in the right way.
In this role you will work as the primary point of contact for MongoDB end users across a large portfolio of growing MongoDB Atlas customers. You will be responsible for acting as the account team leader bringing together Sales, Professional Services, Technical Services, etc. to drive positive outcomes for our customers.
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in São Paulo for our hybrid working model.
Our ideal candidate will have

  • 2+ years experience working in a Customer Success, Account Management, Client Services or other similarly customer-centric role
  • A background and passion for driving growth within a customer portfolio through enablement sessions, strategy meetings, business reviews, etc
  • A mind for technology - we’ll teach you about MongoDB and databases, but our customers and product are inherently technical and you should have an aptitude and curiosity to learn about those concepts
  • The ability to act with a high level of autonomy, you will be expected to take ownership of our customer portfolio and make key decisions to drive effective customer outcomes; including deciding how to de-risk or de-escalate customer issues and conflict, and how to drive effective customer outcomes through both 1 to 1 and 1 to Many activities for the wider portfolio
  • An entrepreneurial mindset - this is a new team at MongoDB where you will be required to both deviate from established procedure and use data-driven analysis to build new process or practices that enhance our service of this customer segment
  • Team player and passion for collaboration - this role will work with some of our most strategic growth customers so must align closely to Sales, Professional Services, Tech Services, and the broader MDB ecosystem
  • Prior exposure to database, cloud, and infrastructure technology is a plus
  • Experience in developing 1:Many customer programs, or customer marketing is a plus
  • Bilingual in Portuguese & English required
On a given day in this role you will
  • Work as a strategic advisor to your customer providing them with guidance on MongoDB best practices and their overall technology strategy; this could include running enablement sessions alone or with another internal MongoDB team members, advising the customer on strategies to optimize their technical environment or current spend with MongoDB, positioning and recommending product features and best practices to accelerate customers time to value and growth

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

description:
Descrição de Cargo: Analista de Suporte Nível 2 (N2)

Horário de Trabalho: 15h às 23h
Experiência Mínima: 2 anos na área de suporte em redes e segurança, com atuação em ambientes NOC (Network Operations Center).
Local: (Inserir localização ou informar se é remoto).

Responsabilidades Principais:

  1. Análise de Capacity e Performance:

    • Realizar análises de capacidade e desempenho de equipamentos de redes, identificando gargalos e propondo melhorias.

  2. Atendimento de Chamados:

    • Atender chamados de nível avançado relacionados a redes e segurança, garantindo resolução eficaz e dentro dos SLAs estabelecidos.

  3. Gestão de Equipamentos:

    • Gerenciar o parque de equipamentos dos clientes e da empresa, assegurando o cumprimento do ciclo de vida, atualizações e melhores práticas.

  4. Desenho e Implementação:

    • Desenhar, implementar, configurar e gerenciar firewalls de múltiplos fabricantes utilizando técnicas avançadas de roteamento e proteção (UTM).
    • Gerenciar redes wireless de grande escala, otimizando desempenho, segurança e resolvendo problemas.
    • Implementar e configurar switches, incluindo VLANs e protocolos avançados de roteamento (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP).

  5. Monitoramento e Diagnóstico:

    • Utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento de rede e análise de tráfego para diagnóstico proativo e prevenção de interrupções.

  6. Documentação Técnica:

    • Criar, revisar e promover documentações técnicas para uso interno e para clientes, garantindo padronização e clareza.

  7. Desenvolvimento de Equipe:

    • Apoiar no desenvolvimento técnico dos analistas de Nível 1 (N1), promovendo treinamentos e compartilhamento de conhecimento.

  8. Gerenciamento de Crises:

    • Gerenciar crises junto ao time e clientes em casos de incidentes de segurança, indisponibilidades ou problemas críticos relacionados à infraestrutura.

Conhecimentos e Qualificações Necessárias:

  • Experiência em Redes:

    • Configuração, gerenciamento e troubleshooting de redes corporativas (LAN, WAN, WLAN).
    • Implementação e manutenção de switches, roteadores e firewalls.
    • Conhecimento em protocolos de roteamento (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP) e VLANs.

  • Conhecimentos Avançados em:

    • Firewalls de múltiplos fabricantes (Fortinet, Cisco, Palo Alto, etc.).
    • Redes wireless de grande escala, com foco em otimização e segurança.
    • Ferramentas de monitoramento e análise de tráfego de rede.

  • Habilidades Adicionais:

    • Capacidade de elaborar relatórios técnicos e gerenciais.
    • Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe.
    • Experiência no atendimento de chamados complexos e em gestão de crises.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações em redes e segurança (ex.: CCNA, CCNP, Fortinet NSE, Palo Alto PCNSE, etc.).
  • Experiência comprovada em ambientes de alta criticidade (NOC/SOC).
  • Familiaridade com metodologias de ITIL e boas práticas de gestão de incidentes.

Senior Strategic Partner Manager, Artist Development, YouTube (English, Portuguese)

Join to apply for the Senior Strategic Partner Manager, Artist Development, YouTube (English, Portuguese) role at Google

Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 1 year of experience interfacing directly with labels, artists, managers, or digital platforms mainly in Brazil's music industry, artists, managers, labels and the digital music space.
  • Ability to communicate in English and Portuguese fluently to engage with local stakeholders.
Preferred qualifications:
  • Experience in Music industry, with understanding of how the industry operates, key players, and where YouTube sits in this ecosystem.
  • Understanding of YouTube’s current efforts in music, its trajectory within the industry.
  • Ability to drive new partnerships, promote new business opportunities to existing partners, and ensure prompt and proper resolution of business issues raised by partners.
  • Ability to cultivate skills in analytics, basic modeling and formal corporate presentations and analyzing data, coordinating internal events, speaking to partners, or negotiating agreements.
  • Ability to think and to develop a goal and a strategy.
About The Job
The YouTube Product Partnerships team drives the partner strategy and manages key relationships that help to make YouTube’s products more universally accessible and useful. We own the business side of new products and initiatives, and our strategic partnerships seek to build, distribute, grow, and protect YouTube’s products globally. We know how to assess partnership opportunities in any situation, define a strategy, and work closely within our team, and with Product, Marketing, and other cross-functional stakeholders to drive critical partnerships that help evolve our business.
As a Strategic Partner Manager you will be responsible for managing YouTube’s relationship emerging and established artists across Brazil. You will work both as external (partner-facing) and internal with many cross-functional initiatives to balance business development and operations at scale. You will work to identify and engage with a dynamic set of artists, promoting initiatives to drive partner satisfaction and results, and optimizing partner performance on the platform. You will posses ability and demonstrated history of cultivating relationships in the music industry, in tandem with a strong understanding of trends in the market and driving results on digital platforms.
At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.
Responsibilities
  • Provide operational support for Artists on the YouTube platform while delivering exceptional service to artists and their teams.
  • Develop and manage a portfolio of emerging and established artists, driving initiatives, platform optimization and best practices, and engagement and product activation.
  • Design, develop and launch music initiatives in the region.
  • Establish a good working relationship with our cross-functional music teams in Partnerships, Global Scaled Services, Business, Product Solutions, Marketing, Public Relations and Product, serving as a music consultant as needed.
  • Identify key metrics to evaluate data both quantitatively and qualitatively. Streamline operational workflow by identifying and eliminating bottlenecks.

description:
The INNIO Advantage By combining a rich legacy in the power and gas compression space with pioneering technology, INNIO brings our customers affordable, reliable and sustainable energy solutions for today and tomorrow. We are helping to meet today’s energy needs with 64 GW of installed capacity and more than 50,000 of our powerful Jenbacher and Waukesha engines, which can be found in more than 100 countries. And, by harnessing our history of energy industry firsts along with the power of digital innovation, we will continue to deliver for the future.

We are looking for the Regional EHS Operations Specialist to complete our Latam team. This position is based in Brazil, work location ideally Campinas.

Role Description :

The purpose of this role is to support robust Environment, Health, and Safety (EHS) practices across LATAM, with a focus on regulatory compliance, risk reduction, and operational excellence for all countries, highlighting Brazil, Peru, and Mexico. This position assists in the development and implementation of EHS programs, contributes to continuous improvement and sustainability initiatives, and ensures alignment with international standards (ISO 45001, ISO 14001, ISO 9001). By providing administrative support, promoting a proactive safety culture, and working closely with management and service teams, this role enhances operational efficiency, supports achievement of key performance indicators (KPIs), and helps safeguard the well-being of all employees and stakeholders.

Responsibilities :

· Oversee Environment, Health, and Safety (EHS) compliance and initiatives across LATAM, focusing on Brazil (NR 1–38), Peru (Ley N° 29783), and Mexico (NOM-STPS), in line with ISO 45001 (Occupational Health & Safety), ISO 14001 (Environmental Management), and ISO 9001 (Quality Management)

· Develop, implement, and update safety, health, and environmental programs, including Electronic Social Security System, Individual Protective Equipment (IPI), Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), and required documentation (PPP – Social Security Professional Profile, AST – Work Safety Analysis, APR – Preliminary Risk Analysis, CAT – Work Accident Communication, ASO – Occupational Health Certificate)

· Provide administrative support to management and service areas.

· Conduct risk assessments, hazard identification, and incident investigations, ensuring corrective actions and compliance

· Lead emergency response planning, regulatory monitoring, and maintain permits, licenses, and documentation

· Inform and train personnel on safe practices, deliver Daily Safety Dialogue (DDS), Safety, Health, and Environment (SSMA) lectures, and EHS trainings, including new hire orientation and medical checks

· Manage environmental licensing, Fire Department Inspection Certificate (AVCB), audits, waste disposal, and documentation uploads

· Promote a proactive safety culture, continuous improvement (Lean, Six Sigma), and Health and Safety Committee participation

· Oversee EHS compliance for contractors and suppliers, and lead sustainability initiatives (waste, energy, water, carbon footprint

· Provide recommendations for operational improvement, support achievement of service key performance indicators (KPIs), and work with the services team to enhance operational efficiency

· Track and report EHS data and KPIs, and support health and wellness programs

· Communicate EHS policies and performance to stakeholders, and support cost optimization and team integration, including language development (English and Spanish)

· Strong collaboration and alignment with EHS Leader at Jenbacher Headquarter

· Perform related other duties as assigned

Qualification Requirements :

· Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Engineering, Occupational Health and Safety, Industrial Engineering, Environmental Science, or a related field.

· Advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., NEBOSH, CSP, ISO lead auditor) are considered a plus.

· Experience supporting EHS (Environment, Health, and Safety) activities in industrial or service sectors, ideally across LATAM

· Strong knowledge of EHS regulations in LATAM countries, with emphasis on Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, and familiarity with ISO 45001, ISO 14001, and ISO 9001 standards

· Demonstrated skills in risk assessment, incident investigation, and regulatory compliance. Experience delivering EHS training and supporting audits, licensing, and documentation

· Involvement in emergency response, sustainability, and process improvement initiatives

· Ability to work with KPIs and assist management teams

· Ability to communicate effectively in English and Spanish

· A Experience collaborating with contractors, suppliers, and cross-functional teams

· Willingness to travel for short periods (incl. internationally), up to 25% or the time, based on needs

Descrição

Somos uma empresa de tecnologia brasileira, fundada em 2013, focada em pesquisa e inteligência de preços. Ajudamos os varejistas a crescerem e evoluírem com a precificação.
Possuímos uma plataforma completa de pricing, do monitoramento da concorrência à precificação inteligente. Acreditamos que o acesso a informações de qualidade beneficia toda a cadeia de valor do varejo, pois permite melhores negociações entre indústria e varejo, e preços mais justos para os consumidores.
São bilhões de dados coletados por ano, transformados em informação por meio de soluções e disponibilizados para clientes e parceiros, proporcionando o monitoramento do mercado, mapeamento de oportunidades, gestão automática e otimização de preços com algoritmos.

O que você fará no seu dia-a-dia:

  • Expandir a base de clientes em potencial da empresa, em especial pelo contato direto com o cliente, mas também através de acompanhamento dos leads gerados;
  • Gerenciar leads de prospecção de forma eficaz com base no processo de vendas existente;
  • Manter o rastreamento eficiente de todos os leads, bem como as ligações de acompanhamento para garantir que os itens prioritários sejam tocados com rapidez e regularidade, e que todas as contas sejam mantidas em dia;
  • Focar em prospects de alto valor e fazer a transição de leads para novas oportunidades, qualificando-os efetivamente antes de passar para o representante de vendas;
  • Determinar os maiores gaps dos clientes em potencial e apresentar efetivamente a proposta de valor por voz, e-mail ou videoconferência;
  • Compreender como criar valor para os clientes e educar os clientes em potencial de uma forma que os atraia;
  • Fornecer feedbacks eficazes à gerência sobre leads bem-sucedidos e malsucedidos, chamadas e setores de clientes em potencial.

Esse é um desafio para quem tem:

  • Mínimo 2 anos de experiência como SDR/BDR;
  • Conhecimento prévio sobre como usar o CRM (preferencialmente Meetime e Pipe Drive);
  • Experiência em softwares B2B;
  • Pensamento lógico e Capacidade de Resolução de problemas;
  • Boa comunicação e Escuta ativa.
